answer_4.quote: To rule this out, we randomly evaluated (using MTurk) 115 paragraphs from C \ F s , and found only 2 (1.7%) could be used in place of f 1 or f 2 to answer the question.
answer_4.guideline: We setup an annotation task on MTurk for turkers to annotate whether a pair of facts has sufficient information to arrive at an answer.
